hypotheses.branch_factor: Depth should allocate search away from high-branching intermediate nodes.
hypotheses.target_hop_prior: Depth should benefit from knowing which first-hop relations historically reach the requested target relation.
hypotheses.budget_allocation: A depth decision is more useful when search budget is concentrated near the predicted proof depth.
hypotheses.gated_behavior: Behavior priors may be useful only after the depth controller has selected a plausible depth.
hypotheses.gated_family: Relation-family similarity may be compatible with depth control only as a weak, high-confidence tie-breaker.
